name: Atlas
concept: The Mountain: the slowest cards in the game and the biggest numbers. He loses almost every speed clash, so he wins by reading the type. His Guard, Take the Hit, turns a blocked Pressure into Charge of his own, and Knockdown on Hammer Sweep, Earthsplitter and Immovable gives him a round of speed. His Break line: Shoulder Check into Hammer Spin. Specials: Lariat, Upheaval and Immovable. Super: Avalanche.

cards.name: Recall
cards.flavour: Cover up, then bring back what you need.

cards.name: Take the Hit
cards.flavour: The mountain doesn't move. It gets angrier.

cards.name: Lariat
cards.flavour: The one quick thing he does.

cards.name: Upheaval
cards.flavour: The hammer comes up faster than it should.

cards.name: Immovable
cards.flavour: They hit a mountain, and the mountain puts them down.

super.name: Avalanche
super.flavour: Once a game: the whole mountain comes down.

notes: v21 (10 November 2026, Mark): HP 26 (v20 28) after the first round-robin. nine Guards (Recall x3, Read x3 and the fighter's own Guard x3, which pays out only if it beats a Pressure), two Guards do nothing, a 28-card deck, and three specials on the table, one of each type (the Super is whichever type suits the fighter). Cut one Hammer Sweep to make room. v20, 9 Nov (evening, Mark): the round's heat stops at the cap (no damage at max), so every HP is lower again to keep games the same length: HP 28 (first pass 32). v20 first balance pass (9 Nov): HP 32 (v19 34), heat cap 10 (v19 12). Under heat a low cap is offence (you reach max sooner, then every Pressure and the round's heat land as damage, and the Super is cheaper), so the v19 caps, set as defence, flipped the balance (Vex and Bastion about 67%, Atlas 31%); every HP is lower to bring time-outs down. v20 (9 November 2026, Mark): heat. Tokens are your fighter powering up: your heat (the grey your Pressures build) is yours, stops at your own cap of 12, and past it lands as straight damage; a Break that beats a Guard spends it all; a Guard that beats your Pressure douses it. No meter: specials cost 3 heat and the Super your whole cap, bought at the end of a round. The core is Recall x3 and Read x3 (Charge gone); one more card of the fighter's own to stay at 26: Shoulder Check x3 (the Convert line had two Starters to three Enders). Otherwise as v19. v19 (8 November 2026, night): two combo lines (Mark): a combo continues only with cards of its Starter's type; grabs stay out of combos except the Warden's. Convert line: Shoulder Check (Starter) into Hammer Spin (Ender). Earthsplitter as the Ender made him 54% on average and 59% against the Benchmark (5 chip and a Knockdown). v19 (8 November 2026, evening): the overflow grey cap (the pile stops at the cap, grey beyond it is lost as HP) and a Convert cashes only as the clash card, so no Convert is a Linker or Ender (Mark). Every HP 2 lower to bring time-outs back into the band. Hammer Spin, Earthsplitter, Upheaval and Avalanche lose Ender; Hammer Sweep is the only Ender. His own grey cap: 12. HP 34. v19 tuning: HP 40. v19 test (8 November 2026): Counter icons only on Pressures (Mark), played with the grey cap (9). Moved from the v18 file: every Convert loses Counter; Hammer Sweep, Lariat gain it. Rules v18 draft, 8 November 2026 (characters v18 draft.md): Pressure 11, Convert 8, Recover 7; HP 38. Pitched, added as written.
